seed.policy: All area-qualified components individually validated with frozen rules, preserve original labels/core; unique qualified only; budget overflow remains unknown, not largest-component selection

s3.policy: Prune only newly-grown weak unsupported terminal graph leaves. Keep union and strong. Tip from coherent supported axial band; unresolved farther visible blue implies weak/unknown, not a shorter confirmed tip. Width-aware inside sampling; unchanged external and color thresholds.

s4.policy: Modify only additions beyond corrected union. Never alter original union/raw stone or strong current blue. Remove only weak shallow geometric protrusions with background-compatible low edge evidence, preserve confirmed distal frontier. Add current-evidence concavities only; no opening/closing/Gaussian imposed mask. Roll back frame edits on budget/connectivity/visible-front failure.

progression.rule: Evaluate 70 causal/132 static, each full video and focus boards. Failing stage still complete all2694 and export; do not implement/run next stage. Engineering-only repairs get new version and full rerun, no threshold tuning.

adoption: Retain prior frozen geometry objectives; progression is nondegradation, not proof of improvement or adoption. No independent tip truth; no accuracy claim from smoothness or confirmation alone.
